info.description:
Read-only API of the public documentation sites. No sign-in is needed. Every request names the
domain the site runs on in the X-Public-Domain header and only gets what is published on that domain:
the style and branding of the site and the published versions of the documentation, as small
ready-to-render files. An unknown domain, a hidden version and a missing file all answer the same 404.
info.title: docs-hub public API

get.description: The top logo (logo_top), the bottom logo (logo_bottom) or the favicon (favicon) of the domain's style.
get.summary: A picture of the site's branding

parameters.description: The domain the site runs on
parameters.name: X-Public-Domain

parameters.description: logo_top, logo_bottom or favicon
parameters.name: kind

get.description:
Returns the texts of the site's interface (keys "site.*") and the captions generated in the
documentation (keys "export.doc.*") in one of the languages of the site.

parameters.description: The domain the site runs on
parameters.name: X-Public-Domain

parameters.description: A language of the site
parameters.name: lang

get.description:
Returns the whole version as Markdown for language models: the services, their text pages and their
endpoints with parameters, bodies, responses and errors, limited to 2 MiB. The site serves it at
/llms-full.txt. The version is the default one unless the version parameter names another. 404 when the SEO
switches the files off.

parameters.description: The domain the site runs on
parameters.name: X-Public-Domain

parameters.description: Preview token for a hidden version
parameters.name: X-Preview-Token

parameters.description: Version ID (default: the default version)
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Language code (default: the default language)
parameters.name: lang

get.description:
Returns the short description of the site for language models (llmstxt.org): the title, the description
and the intro from the SEO, then the pages of the version with links and one-line summaries. The site serves
it at /llms.txt. The version is the default one unless the version parameter names another. 404 when the
SEO switches the files off.

parameters.description: The domain the site runs on
parameters.name: X-Public-Domain

parameters.description: Preview token for a hidden version
parameters.name: X-Preview-Token

parameters.description: Version ID (default: the default version)
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Language code (default: the default language)
parameters.name: lang

get.description:
Returns the robots.txt text of the domain: the group of all robots that allows or closes the site (the SEO
of the domain says which), its extra lines and, for an open site, the address of the sitemap. The site
serves it at /robots.txt. A domain without an SEO is open.

parameters.description: The domain the site runs on
parameters.name: X-Public-Domain

get.description:
Returns the texts, languages, final design tokens (light and dark scheme), branding, top bar, footer and the
list of published versions of the domain named in X-Public-Domain. The texts, the top bar links and the
footer are in the language of the lang parameter; without it, or with a language the site does not have,
they are in the default language, and what a language leaves empty is taken from the default one. The
first version is the default one.

parameters.description: The domain the site runs on
parameters.name: X-Public-Domain

parameters.description: Preview token that adds a hidden version to the list
parameters.name: X-Preview-Token

parameters.description: Language code of the texts (default: the default language)
parameters.name: lang

parameters.name: q

parameters.description: At most this many results (default 30, at most 100)
parameters.name: limit

and pages in the order of the left menu of the documentation.

default_version.description: DefaultVersion is the version the site opens.

language.description:
Language is the language of the texts, the top bar links and the footer of this response; Languages lists every
language of the site.

name.description: Name is the title of the site, TitleTemplate builds the title of a page ({page}, {site}).

noindex.description:
Noindex asks the site to close its pages to search engines (a meta robots tag): the SEO closes the whole site, or
the request holds a preview token of a hidden version.

social.description:
Social are the previews of a link to the site, Verification the codes that prove its ownership to search engines and
Analytics the identifiers of its counters; the site builds the tags and connects the counters itself.

image.description: Image is the preview picture (an absolute path of the public API) or null.

hidden.description: Hidden is true only for a hidden version opened with a preview token.

parameters_label.description: ParametersLabel and ResponseLabel are i18n keys that override the usual captions (AsyncAPI).

request_example.description: RequestExample and ResponseExample are pretty-printed JSON; empty unless the service publishes examples.

summary.description: Summary is the first line of the description, ready for a page's meta description.
Summary is the first line of the page, ready for a page's meta description.

header_link_underline.description:
The style of the links of the top bar (header) and of the footer: underline, weight and size in pixels, in the
normal state and when the pointer is over the link (hover).
